theory AbstractInterp

Abstract interpretation

Sign analysis domain, concretization relation, and sound abstract operations.

Abstract interpretation: sign domain, concretization, and sound operations.

This theory formalizes: 1. An abstract domain `Sign` with elements `SPos`, `SZero`, `SNeg`, and `STop`. 2. Concretization relation `Gamma(s; n)` linking abstract signs to integer values. 3. Abstract operations `NegSign(s)` and `MulSign(s1; s2)`. 4. Soundness and algebraic properties of abstract operations.

22 theorems, 8 abstractions, checked by replaying their tactic scripts on the kernel. Hover any piece of syntax for its kind, surface form, and uniform term; open Tactics, Proof, or Analysis to go deeper.

Original source file
-- | Abstract interpretation: sign domain, concretization, and sound operations.
--
-- This theory formalizes:
-- 1. An abstract domain `Sign` with elements `SPos`, `SZero`, `SNeg`, and `STop`.
-- 2. Concretization relation `Gamma(s; n)` linking abstract signs to integer values.
-- 3. Abstract operations `NegSign(s)` and `MulSign(s1; s2)`.
-- 4. Soundness and algebraic properties of abstract operations.
theory AbstractInterp

comment book "Abstract interpretation: sign analysis domain, concretization, and sound operations."

-- Abstract sign domain:
-- SPos:  positive (> 0)
-- SZero: zero (= 0)
-- SNeg:  negative (< 0)
-- STop:  any integer (top element)
abs Sign == (Unit ⊎ Unit) ⊎ (Unit ⊎ Unit)
abs SPos == inl (inl Ax)
abs SZero == inl (inr Ax)
abs SNeg == inr (inl Ax)
abs STop == inr (inr Ax)

-- Concretization: does integer n satisfy abstract sign s?
abs Gamma(s; n) ==
  decide s of
    inl l => (decide l of inl u => 0 < n | inr u => n = 0 ∈ Int)
  | inr r => (decide r of inl u => n < 0 | inr u => True)

-- Abstract negation:
abs NegSign(s) ==
  decide s of
    inl l => (decide l of inl u => SNeg | inr u => SZero)
  | inr r => (decide r of inl u => SPos | inr u => STop)

-- Abstract multiplication:
abs MulSign(s1; s2) ==
  decide s1 of
    inl l1 =>
      (decide l1 of
         inl u1 =>
           (decide s2 of
              inl l2 => (decide l2 of inl u2 => SPos | inr u2 => SZero)
            | inr r2 => (decide r2 of inl u2 => SNeg | inr u2 => STop))
       | inr u1 => SZero)
  | inr r1 =>
      (decide r1 of
         inl u1 =>
           (decide s2 of
              inl l2 => (decide l2 of inl u2 => SNeg | inr u2 => SZero)
            | inr r2 => (decide r2 of inl u2 => SPos | inr u2 => STop))
       | inr u1 =>
           (decide s2 of
              inl l2 => (decide l2 of inl u2 => STop | inr u2 => SZero)
            | inr r2 => STop))

soft Sign, SPos, SZero, SNeg, STop, Gamma, NegSign, MulSign

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Domain membership
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem spos_member : SPos ∈ Sign
proof
  auto
qed

theorem szero_member : SZero ∈ Sign
proof
  auto
qed

theorem sneg_member : SNeg ∈ Sign
proof
  auto
qed

theorem stop_member : STop ∈ Sign
proof
  auto
qed

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Concretization properties
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

theorem gamma_pos :
  ∀n:Int. 0 < n → Gamma(SPos; n)
proof
  intro n
  intro h
  reduce
  hyp
qed

theorem gamma_zero :
  Gamma(SZero; 0)
proof
  reduce
  eq
qed

theorem gamma_neg :
  ∀n:Int. n < 0 → Gamma(SNeg; n)
proof
  intro n
  intro h
  reduce
  hyp
qed

theorem gamma_top_all :
  ∀n:Int. Gamma(STop; n)
proof
  intro n
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem gamma_top_sound :
  ∀s:Sign. ∀n:Int. Gamma(s; n) → Gamma(STop; n)
proof
  intro s
  intro n
  intro h
  reduce
  auto
qed

theorem neg_involutive :
  ∀s:Sign. NegSign(NegSign(s)) = s ∈ Sign
proof
  intro s
  elim 1 THENL [
    elim 2 THENL [
      reduce THEN auto,
      reduce THEN auto
    ],
    elim 2 THENL [
      reduce THEN auto,
      reduce THEN auto
    ]
  ]
qed
